content: UPC lookup options for liquor bottles: Go-UPC (paid API, explicitly covers beer/wine/liquor brands, JSON API), UPC Database / UPC-search.org (free tiers, broad but inconsistent alcohol coverage), Barcode Lookup API (paid, broad). No single free authoritative liquor-specific API; expect to combine an API lookup with manual fallback entry for misses (recommended given owner is manually curating a recipe/bottle collection anyway).
